reasons.D: Closest movement: short blunt sentences against longer ones, rhetorical questions answered flatly, parenthetical asides and a first-person shrug, just as in the passage's question-and-aside rhythm.
reasons.C: Chatty first-person stance, a parenthetical and a flat closing shrug match well, but tics like 'Very well.' and 'Just so.' lean slightly mannered, and it lacks the passage's run of questions.
reasons.B: Right period register and wry stance, but long polysyndetic sentences and polished similes give a smoother essayist's movement; no questions or parentheses, which the passage leans on heavily.
reasons.A: Modern, neutral explanatory prose with balanced, even sentences and no asides, questions or personal voice; reads nothing like the author's conversational period style.
